During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Thaereian military|military]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Rast'tul]] maintained '''a house''' in a residential district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thaere Privo]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rast'tul kidnapped the [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Night Forael Wren|Night Wren]] and took her to live with him in his house, using her as a pawn to manipulate her mother, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, in about [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a band of freelance agents from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;broke into the house and rescued Night.
